steps.title: The walking machine
steps.narration: Most of the walk lives in the ventral nerve cord. Local interneurons here stitch incoming reports to motor neurons. (Leg sensory somas sit out in the body, so they are not in this volume.)

steps.title: Leg motor neurons
steps.narration: Tibia and trochanter flexors and extensors are the muscles that actually step.

steps.title: Descending drive
steps.narration: MDN (moonwalker) and DNg cells send brain goals down the neck into that VNC machine.

steps.title: Ascending reports
steps.narration: Ascending neurons carry what the VNC computed back up to the brain.
